hypothesis: Op is memory-bound; a fused f32 streaming kernel that re-derives the delta-rule update directly in the stored [V,K] layout (scalar-scaled state + single rank-1 update, gates recomputed in-kernel, no tl.dot/TF32) beats the reference per-head Python loop on all batch sizes.
change_summary: Initial correctness baseline: single fused kernel, parallel unit (batch, v-head, v-block) with fixed BLOCK_V=16, num_warps=4, num_stages=1; gates (g,beta) recomputed in-kernel with guarded softplus; all math f32, no autotune, no masking (BLOCK_V | V=128).
notes: atol=0.01 rtol=0.01 matched_ratio=0.99; rel err max 6.7e-2 on output (bf16) well within tol, f32 state exact. Clear monotone trend with B: B=1 27.82x (launch/occupancy-bound, only 8 heads*8 v-blocks=64 programs) up to B=64 1062.69x (bandwidth-bound). Small-B is the geomean downside per draft H2. sol_ms floor ~0.064ms on B<=16, only B=64 above floor at 0.090ms -> op is launch-overhead-bound. Next: c002 add @triton.autotune over BLOCK_V and num_warps keyed on batch_size.

hypothesis: Small B is occupancy-bound and large B prefers fat tiles; @triton.autotune over BLOCK_V in {8,16,32,64} x num_warps in {1,2,4} keyed on batch_size will pick a per-B-optimal config and raise geomean vs the fixed BLOCK_V=16 of c001.
change_summary: One axis vs c001: wrapped the identical kernel with @triton.autotune(configs=BLOCK_V{8,16,32,64}xwarps{1,2,4}, key=[B]) and switched to a grid=lambda META launch; added B to kernel args for the key. Algebra/dtype/math unchanged.
decision: reject (regression, revert to c001 as parent)
notes: REGRESSION: geomean 134.26x < c001 182.09x. Every workload uniformly ~0.025-0.027ms slower (sol_ms floor rose 0.064->0.091ms; B=64 0.090->0.112ms) with identical correctness/errors. The autotune runtime-dispatch (per-launch key hashing + config cache lookup) plus the grid=lambda callable add a fixed ~0.027ms per launch. Since the op is launch-overhead-bound (GPU work trivial), this fixed overhead dominates and hurts ALL workloads. Confirms H2/H3 are moot here: kernel-execution differences between BLOCK_V configs are below the launch floor, so autotune cannot help and its dispatch cost hurts. Lesson: the real lever is REDUCING per-launch overhead, not tuning tiles. Next: c003 revert autotune, keep fixed BLOCK_V=16/warps=4/static-grid identical to c001 kernel body, but slash kernel argument count (enforce contiguous inputs, derive all offsets from constexpr shapes -> drop ~25 stride scalars) to shrink the launch floor that dominates 4 of 5 workloads.
